invariants.rationale: The key is cast to Pair<HoodieKey, Option<HoodieRecordLocation>>, so it must be non-null and instance of Pair
The left element of the Pair (HoodieKey) is accessed, so it must be non-null.
A method getRecordKey is called on the left object, so getRecordKey() result is likely non-null or at least safely called.
Right side is an Option, so isPresent() must be callable; no forced assumption about presence is made.

invariants.expression: (!(key instanceof Pair)) || key == null || ((Pair<?, ?>)key).getRight() == null || ((Pair<?, ?>)key).getRight().isPresent() || ((Pair<?, ?>)key).getRight().isPresent() == false
invariants.rationale: Covers all conditions for right Option presence state.
